mapper.select: select `f`.*,us.real_name as send_real_name, us.image_url,ur.real_name as receive_real_name from `friend_message` f left join `user` us on f.send_user_id = us.id left join `user` ur on f.receive_user_id = ur.id where 1=1 and (send_user_id = #{sendUserId} and receive_user_id = #{receiveUserId}) or (send_user_id = #{receiveUserId} and receive_user_id = #{sendUserId})
